messages:
vivian: Quick review on PR #4482: added a 'parsing patterns' subsection for tool_call envelopes. A few tiny issues: the example uses `params` (we standardized on `inputs`), and the Node snippet still shows `generate()` instead of `invoke()`.

sam: thanks — can you paste the exact envelope you want in the guide? I'll fix the snippet.

vivian: preferred envelope: `{ "type": "tool_call", "tool": "ocr", "inputs": { "image_url": "https://..." } }` and Node: `await model.invoke('ocr', { inputs: { image_url } })`. Keep examples tiny.

tom: also saw a broken link to the schema: the doc points to `/docs/schemas/tool-envelope.json` but canonical is `/docs/schemas/tool-envelope-v1.json`. links-bot didn't catch because redirect exists, but we should be explicit.

vivian: good catch. tiny plan: 1) switch params->inputs, 2) switch generate->invoke in Node/Python snippets, 3) point schema link to v1, 4) add a one-line migration note mentioning `function_call -> tool_call` and `params -> inputs` so customers searching will find it.

sam: I'll push the fixes. Also propose adding a 1-line defensive JS parse example: `const env = JSON.parse(body||'{}'); const img = env?.inputs?.image_url ?? null;` and a guardrail sentence: "Always validate presence of required input keys before forwarding to tools."

vivian: please add an ajv test in docs CI that validates the sample envelope against the versioned schema. Keep the test name `docs: validate tool-envelope example against schema` so it shows up in summaries.

ci-bot: noted  will add link-check and ajv tests for docs-only CI.

tom: one more tiny SDK nit: comments in Ruby examples still say "function calling" 12 -> replace with "tool calling". Also remove outdated comment about automatic fallback to `generate()`; we don't recommend that.

sam: fixed Ruby comments and removed fallback note. Pushed commit: params->inputs, generate->invoke, schema link -> v1, migration note added, defensive parse snippet, guardrail sentence, ajv test. PTAL.

vivian: LGTM. CI ran but failed once due to flaky CDN; reran and all green now.

ci-bot: docs/ci 1 link-checker success. docs/tests 1 ajv validate passed.

docs-bot: changelog entry added: "Docs: clarify tool_call envelope shape; update examples to invoke(); defensive parsing + schema validation test" (id: docs-4482-fix).

vivian: thanks all. After merge, let's add a short follow-up in the migration doc showing side-by-side before/after snippets for larger integrators. I'll open a follow-up PR.

sam: will do. merging now.

tom: merged 290. closing thread.
